title: Kubernetes 1.36 reaches end-of-life on 2027-06-28
summary: The Kubernetes release history lists Kubernetes 1.36 as supported until its end-of-life date of 2027-06-28; after that the release no longer receives security updates or bug fixes.

constraints: Upstream Kubernetes maintains the three most recent minor releases, about twelve months of patch support each; managed providers (EKS, GKE, AKS) retire minors on their own calendars, often sooner.
Kubernetes upgrades one minor version at a time, and the control plane must be raised before the kubelets that talk to it.
Each minor crossed can remove served API versions; read the Kubernetes Deprecated API Migration Guide before upgrading.

steps.title: Raise the control plane
steps.instructions: Raise the control plane to a supported minor, one version at a time, or let the provider's release channel do it.

steps.title: Raise the nodes
steps.instructions: Raise every node's kubelet to a version compatible with the new control plane.

steps.title: Remove APIs the new versions deleted
steps.instructions: Read the Kubernetes deprecation guide for every minor version crossed and replace removed API versions before applying.

verification.purpose: Confirm the API server and kubectl agree on the new version.
Confirm every node runs a compatible version.
